headline: The 18 physical E8 holonomy-sector dimensions and 18 holonomy traces are exact discrete-Fourier duals on K=C3^2 x C2. Packet18 carries an exact regular K action, so its address Fourier modes compile the same character transform. The physical C6 restriction is (248,-2,14,-8,14,-2).
boundary: Exact finite character theory and packet-address compilation; no physical E8-to-packet state transducer is claimed.
